planner_instructions:
invest runs one US paper portfolio. It has two kinds of Track; on any other Track ignore these instructions.
Portfolio Track (its Report shows portfolio.* views): the only Track that decides or trades. instrument_add covers a symbol; once portfolio_status shows it live, pass its track_add to neige_track_add verbatim, never edited (a retry replays the same Track). A live instrument marked stale has no working research Track: renew it with instrument_set and pass the returned track_add to neige_track_add. If neige_track_add refuses at its open-Track cap (-32409), call neige_user_notify with the open Tracks it lists and the current keys from portfolio_status: each listed Track whose invest-* key is not current is superseded and should be closed. thesis_add raises a thesis on a live symbol (at most 3 open per symbol); thesis_rm retires one; instrument_rm retires a symbol's theses and is refused while it is held. The 研究论点 board shows each assessment; never copy an assessment into prose.
Research Track (added by the portfolio Track under an invest-<VENUE>-<CODE>-<n> key; its Report shows instrument.position and thesis.records): it never trades. Start every step with instrument_status. If it answers superseded (-32409), close this Track with neige_track_close and stop; if it answers forbidden (-32403), stop and say why. Assess each open thesis of your symbol with thesis_set under its version: assessment open, holding, at_risk or broken, a summary of the evidence, and captured neige://source/ references.

account_no.description: Exact operator-verified lb_papertrading account number. Cannot change on an existing ledger.

broker_home.description: Absolute HOME containing the dedicated Longbridge paper-account SDK login.

oauth_client_id.description: Separately authorized official SDK OAuth client; never decrypt CLI credentials.

sdk_python_path.description: Absolute Python interpreter with the official Longbridge SDK 5.2.0.

access_region.description: Official SDK access point. Select cn on the mainland-China network. No endpoint override or fallback.

portfolio_track_id.description: The portfolio Track: the only Track that may decide, execute or read the portfolio, and the creator every research Track must have.

instrument_recipe_id.description: The stored research recipe (instrument-recipe.md) that every research Track is added from.

max_held.description: Most symbols held at once (weighted above 0 or in a position), 1-255; max_held + max_watched <= 255.

max_watched.description: Most covered symbols that are not held, 1-255; the kernel open-Track cap must be at least max_held + max_watched + 1.

max_weight_bps.description: Largest target weight of one symbol, 1-10000 basis points of account value.

cash_buffer_bps.description: Cash reserve, 1-2000 basis points; weights sum to at most 10000 minus this.

max_order_bps.description: Largest single order, 1-10000 basis points of account value, including a 1% price reserve.

quote_max_age_seconds.description: Quote freshness required to send an order, 1-120 seconds.

lease_days.description: Days a live symbol's research Track may stay silent before portfolio_status marks it stale, 1-90. A new key must be seen within 120 minutes of issue.

opening_positions.description: JSON array of {"symbol": "US:SPY", "shares": 13}: the holdings already in the account when this ledger starts. Must equal the broker's holdings at the first reconciliation; immutable per ledger; at most max_held symbols.

exposes_tools.name: portfolio_status
exposes_tools.description: Portfolio Track Planner or Worker. Read the persisted portfolio without contacting the broker: snapshot (check its time), positions, target weights, covered instruments (pending/live/dropped, held or watched, version, current research key, its track_add, last_seen_at, stale), open theses, limits, decisions with their order legs, fills and errors.

exposes_tools.name: decision_add
exposes_tools.description: Portfolio Track Planner only. Persist an immutable target-weight decision over live covered US instruments with captured sources and validity; never reads or writes the broker. A symbol left out, or at 0, is sold. Each weight <= max_weight_bps, the sum <= 10000 - cash_buffer_bps, and symbols weighted above 0 plus those still in a position <= max_held (rotate a full book in two decisions: sell, then buy once the sells settle). One unresolved decision at a time; repeating the same decision returns it. Then declare a read-only codex Worker task whose goal names the decision_id.

decision_id.description: 1-55 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, so the Worker task key inv-exec-<decision_id> is valid.

symbol.description: VENUE:CODE, US only, for example US:SPY.

message.description: Why these weights: the sourced reasoning shown in the decision log.

exposes_tools.name: execution_add
exposes_tools.description: Portfolio Track Worker only. Durably request execution of the exact persisted, unexpired, queued decision (state becomes requested) and wake the App's loop; this call never contacts the broker. The loop sends one regular-session DAY market order per symbol outside the drift band to the pinned official PAPER account, one at a time, sells first, buys from settled cash only. Repeating the request records nothing. Poll portfolio_status until the decision is done, noop or expired, or your stated limit; its error says why it waits. Uncertain orders are never resubmitted.

exposes_tools.name: instrument_add
exposes_tools.description: Portfolio Track Planner only. Cover a US symbol: it is pending until the loop sees a broker quote, then live with research key invest-<VENUE>-<CODE>-<n> and its track_add in portfolio_status, or dropped. Needs fewer than max_watched watched symbols (covered, not held). Adding a covered symbol changes nothing; re-adding a dropped one issues the next key.

symbol.description: VENUE:CODE, US only, for example US:SPY.

message.description: Why: the audit note journaled with this change.

exposes_tools.name: instrument_set
exposes_tools.description: Portfolio Track Planner only. Renew a live symbol's research key: issue key n+1, which supersedes every older key's Track, and return the new track_add. Pass it verbatim to neige_track_add. Use it for a stale symbol, or after a research Track was added with other arguments.

symbol.description: VENUE:CODE, US only, for example US:SPY.

expected_version.description: The version portfolio_status shows; a stale one is refused.

message.description: Why: the audit note journaled with this change.

exposes_tools.name: instrument_rm
exposes_tools.description: Portfolio Track Planner only. Drop a covered symbol and retire its open theses; refused while it is held (weighted above 0 by the latest decision, or in a position). Its research Track is superseded and closes itself on its next call.

symbol.description: VENUE:CODE, US only, for example US:SPY.

expected_version.description: The version portfolio_status shows; a stale one is refused.

message.description: Why: the audit note journaled with this change.

exposes_tools.name: instrument_status
exposes_tools.description: Research Track Planner only. Your symbol's research view: state, key, held or watched, target weight, position, its open theses (with versions) and the 20 latest retired. Also refreshes this Track's instrument.position and thesis.records views. Allowed only on a Track the portfolio Track added under the symbol's current key: an older key or a dropped symbol answers -32409 superseded (close this Track), anything else -32403.

exposes_tools.name: thesis_add
exposes_tools.description: Portfolio Track Planner only. Raise a thesis on a live symbol for its research Track to assess; at most 3 open theses per symbol. Starts with assessment open, version 1. Repeating the same thesis returns it.

symbol.description: VENUE:CODE, US only, for example US:SPY.

exposes_tools.name: thesis_set
exposes_tools.description: Research Track Planner only, attested as instrument_status is. Assess one open thesis of your own symbol under its version: the new assessment, a summary of the evidence and its captured sources. The portfolio's board shows the change on its next tick.

expected_version.description: The version portfolio_status shows; a stale one is refused.

exposes_tools.name: thesis_rm
exposes_tools.description: Portfolio Track Planner only. Retire one open thesis under its version; it leaves the board and stays in its research Track’s history.

expected_version.description: The version portfolio_status shows; a stale one is refused.

message.description: Why: the audit note journaled with this change.

exposes_tools.name: series_show
exposes_tools.description: Chart resolver only: the kernel calls it in the background for a report's chart.series block; an agent call is refused (-32403). Historical daily, weekly or monthly bars for up to 8 US assets from the official SDK's forward-adjusted daily candlesticks, under the market.series contract: all seven keys required and checked, nothing defaulted. `as_of` is the CUTOFF day; a bar or period is returned only when the source already lists a LATER daily bar, the proof that it closed, in live and frozen mode alike (US is never relaxed). Weekly (ISO, Monday-Sunday) and monthly bars are aggregated from daily ones. Each reply item is `{asset, currency?, status, complete_through?, points?, reason?}`: `asset` echoes the request string; `status` is `ok`, `unknown_asset` (not a US asset) or `unavailable`; `complete_through` is the newest daily bar listed before the window was fetched; `points` are `[ts_ms, <one value per requested field, in request order>]`, `ts_ms` the UTC midnight of the bar or period start, strictly ascending, at least two. One asset's failure never fails another's.

series.description: US asset names `US:<CODE>`, for example `US:SPY`. Any other name answers `unknown_asset` for that item.

fields.description: Which values each point carries, in this order after `ts_ms`.

period.description: Bar size. Week and month are aggregated from daily bars: open of the first day, close of the last, max high, min low, summed volume; `ts_ms` is the period's first day.

mode.description: `frozen` for a block with its own `as_of`; `live` when the kernel filled `as_of` with yesterday UTC. Required, never defaulted.

start.description: First day of the window (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD, a real calendar date, not later than `as_of`.

as_of.description: Cutoff day (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD, a real calendar date.

deadline_ms.description: Unix milliseconds after which the caller no longer wants the answer; a request dequeued past it is refused without an SDK call.
